{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The national electorate remains sharply and almost evenly divided.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"African-American voters demonstrated steadfastness.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A progressive Latino and Asian electorate is growing in importance.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Female voters were mobilized.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A majority of white voters, in particular older males, voted for the preferred candidates of the 1 percent across vast swatches of the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those states awarded their electoral votes to Romney.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Statehouses and governors in those states remain committed to austerity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Statehouses and governors in those states remain committed to gerrymandering election districts to favor Republicans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Statehouses and governors in those states remain committed to suppressing social movements.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In lower-turnout non-presidential election years, a toxic flood of campaign cash, voter suppression and gerrymandering could keep the current status quo.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To sustain the progressive coalition and ensure future victories, the election has to lead to legislative accomplishments that favor the 99 percent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Passively relying on demographic changes in the electorate would be a disastrous strategy.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
